summary: Monticello Regional Airport is a small general aviation facility serving Monticello, Iowa, and the surrounding Jones County region in eastern Iowa. The airport primarily supports private aircraft, flight training, and recreational flying, serving as a convenient alternative to larger commercial hubs in the area. Its modest size and rural setting make it a practical base for local pilots and visitors to the eastern Iowa region.
